item.title: Membership Application
item.description: Membership Application admin-fcac-v2 Tue, 01/28/2025 - 14:26 Thank you for your interest in joining Fairfax Public Access! If you are ready to join, please click the button below. You will need to fill out the Membership Application and then make your payment of $26 USD via Stripe. You also have the option to make an additional $4 USD donation to FPA bringing your total to $30 USD. If you do not wish to donate the additional $4 USD, you can change the quantity to zero "0" for a total of $26 USD.
